ruleDefinitions.name: Azure Point-to-site VPN Modified or Deleted
ruleDefinitions.description: Identifies when a Point-to-site VPN is Modified or Deleted. Note: Unmapped fields: operationName

sequences.query: (operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/P2SVPNGATEWAYS\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/P2SVPNGATEWAYS\/DELETE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/P2SVPNGATEWAYS\/RESET\/ACTION" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/P2SVPNGATEWAYS\/GENERATEVPNPROFILE\/ACTION" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/P2SVPNGATEWAYS\/DISCONNECTP2SVPNCONNECTIONS\/ACTION" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/P2SVPNGATEWAYS\/PROVIDERS\/MICROSOFT\.INSIGHTS\/DIAGNOSTICSETTINGS\/WRITE")
